Insertion of new section 4A, Act LVI of 1973

ORDINANCE III OF 1998
ORDINANCE III OF 1998
NATIONAL REGISTRATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1998
As Ordinance further to amend the National Registration Act, 1973
F.No.2(1)/98-Pub dated
6-2-1998.--The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published
for general information:---
2. Insertion of new section 4A, Act LVI of 1973.-In the National
Registration Act, 1973 (LVI of 1973), after section 4, the following new
section shall be inserted namely:-- '
"4A.
Registration database.--(1) Notwithstanding anything contained in any other law
the Federal Government may establish anti maintain a database to facilitate
identification of citizens for registration and for purposes of planning or any
other purpose permitted by law.
(2) For purposes of subsection
(1) the Federal Government may seek and collate information obtained under the
Census Ordinance, 1959 (X of 1959), or any statutory re-enactment thereof, and
may also carry put surveys with the assistance of the civil administration or
the Armed Forces.
(3) Tile date of any survey under subsection (2) shall be
published in the official Gazette twenty-one days before the commencement of a
survey.
